meta_title: Premier Landscapes | Garden Design & Maintenance Liverpool
meta_description: Premier Landscapes Liverpool offers expert garden design, landscaping and maintenance. Transform your outdoor space today. Call 07519 220241 for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Award-Winning Garden Design — Free Site Surveys
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete garden transformations, we design and build outdoor spaces that work for your lifestyle.
services_subhead: We handle everything from initial design through to planting and maintenance, so you can enjoy a stunning garden without the work.

services.title: Bespoke Garden Design
services.desc: Tailored designs that match your style and budget. We survey your space, understand your needs, and create a detailed plan before any work starts.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping
services.desc: Professional installation of patios, decking, raised beds and retaining walls. We use quality materials and ensure proper drainage and foundations.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Expert selection and planting of trees, shrubs and perennials suited to your soil and sunlight. Low-maintenance schemes available.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular grass cutting, hedge trimming, weeding and seasonal tidying. Monthly or quarterly visits keep your garden looking sharp year-round.

services.title: Lawn Care & Seeding
services.desc: Aeration, overseeding, moss control and feeding programmes to restore tired grass. New lawns laid from turf or seed.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Removal
services.desc: Safe felling, crown reduction and stump grinding by experienced teams. All waste responsibly recycled or chipped.

about_pullquote: We treat every garden like it's our own back yard.
about_para_1: Premier Landscapes has been transforming Liverpool gardens for nearly two decades. Started by head gardener Mark Thompson in 2008, we've grown from a one-man operation to a trusted team of eight designers, landscapers and horticulturists. Every member holds current qualifications in garden design, health and safety, and arboriculture.
about_para_2: Our reputation rests on listening first and talking second. We don't push unnecessary work; we focus on what genuinely improves your outdoor space and fits your budget. Most of our new customers come through word of mouth from neighbours and repeat clients who've used us for 10+ years.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolute game-changer for our back garden. Mark and the team completely redesigned a scruffy patch into a proper outdoor living space. They explained every decision, sourced really good plants and finished on budget. Couldn't fault them.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Been using Premier Landscapes for monthly maintenance for three years now. Reliable, professional, and they treat the garden with real care. Never had to chase them or worry about quality. Genuinely brilliant service.
reviews.author: Janet M.

reviews.text: Had a massive oak tree that was shading the whole garden. They felled it safely, ground out the stump and replanted with something better. Quick, clean job and they even took all the waste. Couldn't recommend them more.
reviews.author: Richard T.
